title: Cool Breeze Citrus Mist

diffuser.notes: Add to a cool-mist diffuser for a refreshing, airy lift.

spray_optional.note: Shake well before each use; mist into the air.

why_it_works: Sweet orange uplifts with citrus brightness, lavender calms the heat, and peppermint adds a cooling, crisp edge—perfect for summer days.
safety: Avoid eyes/mucosa; keep from children & pets.
Consult a professional if pregnant, nursing, or under care.
